win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 14. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: JUSTICE REELS
wilds.behavior:
When a Spinman symbol lands it expands into a Wild Justice Reel if the expanded symbol is a part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

 When the Justice Reel expands, it activates a Booster Wheel. The Booster Wheel spins and lands on one of six Multipliers or a MAX WIN that is instantly awarded. The Multipliers will be selected from Bronze, Silver, or Gold value brackets to form the six Multiplier values on the Wheel.

 The three value brackets have the following Multiplier values:

 Bronze: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x

 Silver: 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x

 Gold: 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x, MAX WIN

 The Multiplier on which the arrow lands will be applied to the entire Justice Reel. If a winning combination includes more than one Justice Reel, the Multiplier values will first be added together from left to right and then applied to the win.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - REEL HEROES
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This Hidden Epic Bonus guarantees that at least 2 Spinman symbols land on each spin and that the Multiplier values on the Booster Wheels are all a minimum of 5x!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins.

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Justice Reel substitutes for other paying symbols in the paytable.

 Only one Spinman symbol can land on a reel at a time.
